program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (point< a b)
      (or (< (fst a) (fst b))
          (and (= (fst a) (fst b)) (< (snd a) (snd b)))))
    (define (ordered-pair pts)
      (let ((a (first pts)) (b (second pts)))
        (if (point< b a) (list b a) (list a b))))
    (define (pair-record color)
      (let ((pts (ordered-pair (find-color g color))))
        (list color (first pts) (second pts))))
    (define (range-between a b)
      (if (<= a b) (range a (+ b 1)) (range a (- b 1) -1)))
    (define colors
      (filter (lambda (color) (= (length (find-color g color)) 2)) (grid-colors g 0)))
    (define records
      (sort (map pair-record colors)
            (lambda (x y) (point< (second x) (second y)))))
    (define (path-cells rec)
      (let* ((color (first rec))
             (a (second rec))
             (b (third rec)))
        (append
          (map (lambda (c) (list (fst a) c color)) (range-between (snd a) (snd b)))
          (map (lambda (r) (list r (snd b) color)) (range-between (fst a) (fst b))))))
    (paint-cells g (flatmap path-cells records))))
